description: Five gate stretchers, each turning a trigger into a gate of up to 10 seconds set by a knob and a CV input

params.text: Sets that channel's gate length in seconds, from 0 to 10 seconds, before the CV input is added to it

inputs.text: A rising edge starts a gate at that channel's output, and an edge arriving during a gate restarts it at the length set then
Adds to the knob to set that channel's gate length, one volt per second, with the sum clamped to 0-10 seconds

outputs.text: Carries a 10V gate that starts on the trigger and lasts for the length set for that channel

notes: each display shows that channel's current gate length in seconds.
